dataQuality.title: Data Quality
dataQuality.intro: Measured tracking problems of your site, ranked by impact: missing required fields, schema errors, invalid values, duplicates, currency and value problems, event drops, conversion spikes and revenue leaks — each with its evidence and, where the configuration can fix it, a reviewable draft.
dataQuality.noSiteText: Create your first site to get a tracking ID; the quality scan starts with the first events.

summary.lastScanNever: The quality scan has not run for this site yet — nothing has been measured.
summary.staleScan: The last quality scan ran on {date}, more than a day ago. The inbox may be behind the live data.

categoryHelp.required_fields: Events that arrived without a field the standard event requires (order ID, currency, value).
categoryHelp.schema: Events outside the published event plan or with an unexpected shape.
categoryHelp.values: Values that are zero or negative, or currencies that differ from the site currency.
categoryHelp.duplicates: The same order reported twice by the same path; duplicates are dropped and never billed.
categoryHelp.drops: Events rejected at ingest or a sudden fall in the volume of a critical event.
categoryHelp.spikes: Conversions far above the daily average — worth verifying before ad platforms optimise on them.
categoryHelp.revenue: Verified orders or leads that did not reach a destination, or were never captured in the browser.
categoryHelp.usage: Warnings about the monthly event limit of your plan.
categoryHelp.delivery: Failures while delivering events to destinations.

empty.title: No issues in this view
empty.text: Change the status or category filter to see other issues.
empty.noIssuesAtAll: No issues recorded for this site
empty.scanned: The last scan on {date} found nothing to report for the last 24 hours. This is a measurement, not a guarantee: the scan checks the standard events and destinations described in the categories.
empty.scanPending: The quality scan has not run for this site yet, so this is not a health statement. Check back after the worker's next run.

issue.impactHelp: 0–100 from severity, the share of affected events and the known value.
issue.staleHelp: Not observed for more than {days} days. It is not resolved automatically — resolve it when you have checked.
issue.noSamples: No sample events are stored for this issue; the counts come from aggregates.
issue.fixTool: Track AI tool for this issue: {tool}

kinds.currency_mismatch: {event}: currency differs from the site currency
kinds.signal_gap: Verified orders without a browser event
kinds.usage_limit_70: 70 % of the monthly event limit used
kinds.usage_limit_90: 90 % of the monthly event limit used

actions.readOnly: Changing the status or preparing drafts needs the developer, admin or owner role.

mute.title: Mute this issue
mute.description: A muted issue keeps being measured but leaves the open list. Give a reason your team will understand later.
mute.reasonHint: For example: known test traffic, fix scheduled for the next release.

fix.title: Prepare fix draft
fix.description: Track creates or updates the open configuration draft for {environment}. Nothing is published: the draft goes through lint, review and release like every other change.
fix.neverPublishes: A draft never changes live tracking. Publishing stays a separate, confirmed step in Releases.

codes.authoritative_shop: Make the connected {platform} shop the authoritative source of purchase events: verified orders carry order ID, value and currency and supersede browser purchases with the same order ID.
codes.add_event: Add the custom event "{event}" to the event plan (enabled, not critical, API trigger) so it is planned, mapped and monitored.
codes.destination_hybrid: Switch {destination} from browser-only to hybrid delivery so verified {event} events are also sent server-side.
codes.enable_event: Re-enable the event "{event}" in the configuration; it is currently disabled.

unavailable.no_bundle: No configuration has been published for this environment yet, so there is nothing to draft against.
unavailable.connect_shop: The configuration cannot add missing order data. Connect your shop so verified orders become the authoritative source.
unavailable.site_change: This has to be fixed where the event is sent: the site or shop must provide {field} for {event}. Track never fills in missing values.
unavailable.needs_mapping: {destination} has no mapping for {event}. Add the mapping in Destinations first.
unavailable.destination_health: The cause lies in the delivery to the destination. Check credentials, rate limits and errors in Destinations.
unavailable.consent: Consent decides here. Review the consent policy and the CMP setup; Track does not loosen consent by itself.
unavailable.billing: This is a plan limit. Choose overage or a plan change in Billing.
unavailable.not_applicable: No configuration change can fix this; it needs a human check.
unavailable.already_drafted: A fix draft already exists for this issue.

fix.noEnvironment: Select an environment in the header first; the draft belongs to one environment.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.no_environment: The selected environment does not belong to this site.
errors.no_fix: No configuration draft is available for this issue.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

ai.prompt: Explain the data quality issue "{title}" on {site} and propose a fix as a draft. Evidence: {summary}

leaks.title: Signal gaps & revenue leaks
leaks.intro: Verified orders or leads from your shop webhooks and server sources compared with what Track observed, deduplicated and delivered per destination. Gaps come with their reason and their uncertainty; missing revenue, orders or identities are never filled in.

sources.title: Authoritative sources
sources.none: No verified source is connected. Without shop webhooks or a verified server source there are no authoritative orders to compare against — the report stays empty rather than estimating.
sources.hint: Connect Shopify, WooCommerce or Shopware, or create a server source key, to get authoritative orders.

empty.title: No reconciliation yet
empty.text: The worker has not computed snapshots for this site, period and conversion type. Nothing is estimated in the meantime.

leaks.stale: The newest snapshot is from {date}; the report may be behind the live data.
leaks.honesty: Counts are verified records. Values are only summed when every valued record shares one currency; orders without a value are counted but never valued. A browser-side pixel delivery cannot be observed and stays unknown.

summary.title: {kind} in the period
summary.mixed: Mixed currencies — values are not summed
summary.noBase: No verified records in the period
summary.leakHelp: Lower bound: confirmed gaps; upper bound: plus the gaps with unknown outcome.
summary.unknownHelp: Deliveries Track cannot observe (browser pixels, in-flight retries).
summary.deliveredHelp: Verified records with at least one successful server-side delivery.
summary.browserHelp: {n} verified records have a matching browser event with the same order ID.
summary.duplicatesHelp: Same order reported twice by the same path; never billed, never delivered twice.

help.no_consent: The visitor did not grant the purpose the destination requires. Track does not send it — and does not loosen consent.
help.blocked: The destination was paused, not mapped for this event, browser-only, or the policy blocked inferred data.
help.not_captured: The shop reported the order, but no browser event with that order ID reached Track (snippet missing, blocked, or checkout outside the site).
help.delivery_failed: Delivery was attempted and failed or was dead-lettered. Check the destination's health and errors.
help.unknown: Track cannot observe the outcome: browser-side pixel deliveries, retries still in flight, or events outside the retention window.

destinations.title: Per destination
destinations.name: Destination
destinations.noData: No snapshot for this destination in the period.
destinations.empty: No destinations configured for this site.
